scope: STOP_LOSS / SELL / REDUCE / PROFIT_CHECK signal eligibility/timing conditional on both current and comparator paths having a valid open position.

sourceAudit.stopLoss: stop.level == risk; quantity fields only populate heldAmount/heldShares after position existence
sourceAudit.sell: hasPosition && sellBelow threshold && latest15 close condition
sourceAudit.reduce: hasPosition && reduceAt reached && latest15 bearish && volumeRatio >= 1.3

necessaryPrecondition: both allocator paths independently have a valid open position at the event time
same non-sizing plan fields, code version and market data
state/lifecycle provenance must not be copied from current path into comparator
consequence: Conditional on open-position state existing in both paths, signal timing for STOP_LOSS/SELL/REDUCE/PROFIT_CHECK may share the observed trigger clock; action quantity must be recomputed from each path's own holdings.
caveats: A comparator with no fill/open position cannot inherit current exit signals.
REDUCE quantity differs with holdings even when trigger time is shared.
After a REDUCE, later state paths can diverge and must be independently tracked.
This does not certify broker fill timing/price.
